information.description:
Fanatics are Scouts that handled their initiation better, and are thus permitted guns over blades. That’s about it. The only catch is their choice of firearm tends to vary wildly from psycho to psycho, as it’s usually just whatever they can find laying nearby.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Maelstrom).
